$comment: awesome's default keybinds: the Key bindings section of etc/xdg/awesome/rc.lua in nixpkgs' awesome (nixos-26.05). The action is `globalkeys: ` or `clientkeys: ` plus the bound function as rc.lua writes it (whitespace collapsed; the tag binds of the `for i = 1, 9` loop with i filled in, keys #10-#18 are keycodes of the 1-9 row). Label and group from the key's description. Regenerate with scripts/keybinds/extract-x11-wms.py.

binds.label: Show help

binds.label: View next
